name: MyBatis ${} string interpolation SQL injection
attack_scenario: Attacker sends orderBy=id;DROP TABLE sys_user-- or (CASE WHEN ...) for blind extraction; because ${} concatenates the value verbatim, the injected SQL alters the query structure and reads or destroys arbitrary tables.
negative_test_hint: send orderBy = "id;DROP TABLE sys_user--" and assert the injected SQL never reaches the database because the value is rejected or bound, not concatenated

exemplar.explanation: MyBatis substitutes ${} by raw string concatenation into the SQL text, while #{} is a bound PreparedStatement parameter, so any user value reaching ${} (classically ORDER BY or dynamic column names, where #{} cannot be used) is injectable. Values must go through #{} bindings and dynamic identifiers through an explicit allowlist, never raw interpolation.
